summary: Phio Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) on October 13, 2026, disclosing its first commercial-scale cGMP batch of PH-762 drug substance, a manufacturing milestone supporting a planned Phase 2b trial initiation in Q1 2027. The batch met specifications per Certificate of Analysis and Compliance under ICH Q7. No deal terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor were stated. This is an operational pipeline update, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies beyond routine clinical and financing execution risk.
